meta.title: Connect Gmail to Claude, Cursor & MCP Clients
meta.description: Connect Gmail to Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT and any MCP client in one click with Google OAuth. Let AI read, send, schedule and organize your Gmail — inboxes and tool calls free.

hero.titleLine2: and Cursor, ChatGPT, any MCP client
hero.lead: Give your AI agent a real Gmail inbox in minutes. Read, search, send, reply, schedule and organize mail with one-click Google sign-in — and use the same inbox in every MCP client, not just one.

method.title: How Gmail connects: one-click Google OAuth
method.body: Gmail connects with Google OAuth — sign in with Google, approve read and send access, and you're connected. No app password, no IMAP settings to dig up. Revoke access anytime from your Google account or the mcpemails dashboard.

verificationNote.title: What Google will show you
verificationNote.body: Google shows a “Google hasn't verified this app” screen for any app it has not reviewed — click Advanced, then Go to mcpemails.com to continue. That review requires a paid third-party security assessment we have chosen not to buy, so the screen is here to stay. Once connected, the inbox stays connected: access renews automatically and stops only if you revoke it from your Google account.

caps.title: A Gmail inbox your agent can actually use
caps.sub: Nine action-based MCP tools — not just drafts. Your agent finishes the job inside Gmail.

capabilities.p: List, read and search across labels — find that invoice, summarize a thread, or pull the latest from a sender.
Compose and send real messages, reply in-thread, and forward — directly from Gmail, not as a draft you finish by hand.
Queue a message to go out at the right time, so your agent can draft now and send on schedule.
Keep the inbox tidy — apply labels, archive what's handled, and delete on request.

how.title: Connect Gmail in three steps
how.sub: From sign-up to first AI email in a couple of minutes.

steps.p: Sign up for mcpemails — no card required. The free plan gives you unlimited inboxes and 2,500 billable actions per billing period.
Click Connect Gmail, sign in with your Google account, and approve read and send access. No app password or IMAP setup.

steps.h: Paste the MCP URL into your AI
steps.p: Drop https://mcpemails.com/api/mcp into Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT, authorize, and your agent has the inbox.

ctaBand.title: Give your AI a Gmail inbox
ctaBand.sub: Connect Gmail in minutes — unlimited inboxes and 2,500 billable actions per billing period on the free plan, no card required.

method.title: How Zoho connects: IMAP and an app password
method.body: Zoho Mail connects over IMAP/SMTP. Enable IMAP access in Zoho first (it is off by default), generate an application-specific password if you use two-factor authentication, then paste it into mcpemails with your Zoho address. mcpemails supports every Zoho data-center region.

caps.title: A Zoho inbox your agent can actually use
caps.sub: Nine action-based MCP tools, not just drafts. Your agent finishes the job inside Zoho Mail.

capabilities.p: List, read and search across folders to find that invoice, summarize a thread, or pull the latest from a sender.

how.title: Connect Zoho in four steps

steps.p: Sign up for mcpemails, no card required. The free plan gives you unlimited inboxes and 2,500 billable actions per billing period.

steps.h: Enable IMAP and generate an app password
steps.p: In Zoho Mail, turn on IMAP access (Settings, Mail Accounts, IMAP Access). If you use two-factor authentication, generate an application-specific password in Zoho Account, Security.
Add your Zoho address and the password, and pick your Zoho region if asked, to connect the inbox securely.
